name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_malignant_neoplasm_of_breast_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of malignant neoplasm of the breast (breast cancer).
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of malignant neoplasm of the breast (breast cancer).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of malignant neoplasm of the breast (breast cancer).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of malignant neoplasm of the breast (breast cancer).

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_malignant_neoplasm_of_breast_now@@diagnosed_histologically
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the diagnosis of malignant neoplasm of the breast (breast cancer) is established by histological examination.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's diagnosis of malignant neoplasm of the breast (breast cancer) is established by histological examination.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's diagnosis of malignant neoplasm of the breast (breast cancer) is not established by histological examination.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the diagnosis is established by histological examination.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_primary_tumor_tissue_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether primary tumor tissue is currently available from the patient.
when_true: Set to true if primary tumor tissue is currently available from the patient.
when_false: Set to false if primary tumor tissue is not currently available from the patient.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether primary tumor tissue is available from the patient.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_plasma_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether plasma is currently available from the patient.
when_true: Set to true if plasma is currently available from the patient (e.g., as a biospecimen).
when_false: Set to false if plasma is not currently available from the patient.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether plasma is available from the patient.

name: patient_is_exposed_to_deoxyribonucleic_acid_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether deoxyribonucleic acid is currently available from the patient.
when_true: Set to true if deoxyribonucleic acid is currently available from the patient (e.g., as a biospecimen).
when_false: Set to false if deoxyribonucleic acid is not currently available from the patient.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether deoxyribonucleic acid is available from the patient.

name: patient_has_plasma_dna_available_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether both plasma and deoxyribonucleic acid are currently available from the patient.
when_true: Set to true if both plasma and deoxyribonucleic acid are currently available from the patient.
when_false: Set to false if either plasma or deoxyribonucleic acid is not currently available from the patient.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether both plasma and deoxyribonucleic acid are available from the patient.

name: patient_has_high_circulating_tumor_dna_content_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the circulating tumor deoxyribonucleic acid content in plasma is considered high.
when_true: Set to true if the circulating tumor deoxyribonucleic acid (cell-free DNA) content in plasma is considered high according to protocol or investigator definition.
when_false: Set to false if the content is not considered high.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the content is high.

name: patient_rejects_participation
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has rejected participation in the study.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has explicitly rejected participation in the study.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not rejected participation in the study.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has rejected participation in the study.
